findings.title: service container memory=1700g equals parent slice MemoryMax=1700G while head 8g and monitor 2g share the slice
findings.evidence: service 32 CPU/1700g; slice MemoryMax=1700G=1825361100800; head and monitor also use --cgroup-parent=run.slice. Sum of child limits exceeds parent.
findings.impact: parent slice enforces before the service reaches its declared limit; effective service ceiling about 1690 GiB. Planned anonymous peak (716 GiB pool plus engine/Ray) is below; page cache is reclaimable. No false pass; high peak OOMs fail-closed.
findings.minimal_fix: set service memory to 1690g or raise slice MemoryMax and update preflight/tests; alternatively require a sampled service peak plus head plus monitor below slice MemoryMax.

findings.title: double admission with elapsed-time drift at exact 3600/510 second boundary
findings.evidence: outer check admits remaining>=budget+180; bootstrap rechecks a few seconds later with the same threshold; a launch exactly at the minimum is rejected by the child.
findings.impact: false rejection only; no unsafe admission; operator normally has hours of margin.
findings.minimal_fix: require budget+180+startup_slack at the outer check, or pass the supervisor's remaining to the child/remove the duplicate check; add a test with simulated elapsed seconds.

findings.title: release GPU baseline comes from prepare_host and is not guaranteed clean
findings.evidence: prepare_host calls preflight(monitor_required=False), which does not assert empty nvidia-smi compute apps; launch does that later. A foreign GPU process during preparation raises the baseline.
findings.impact: the 61-second no-GPU-process check remains strict; only the memory-retention tolerance can be widened by a high baseline.
findings.minimal_fix: record the baseline after an explicit empty compute-apps check at prepare/launch and use that clean baseline; record its source.

findings.title: accept trusts model-result for business gold and weight equality instead of re-reading raw response and audit files
findings.evidence: accept checks status/cycles/weight_format/16 coverage/contract counts/helper/PSS, but does not re-read cycleN-case.json or current/runtime-rankN.json; validation performs the equality.
findings.impact: independence gap; a false or incorrectly written model-result would not be caught by accept, although the raw evidence is retained.
findings.minimal_fix: accept re-reads the hash-pinned gold and rechecks three responses and the 32 rank files via weight_state (or records their SHA); retain raw evidence.

findings.title: human-readable timer comparison depends on host timezone
findings.evidence: deadline from +08:00 is formatted without conversion and compared to systemctl NextElapseUSecRealtime, which is host-local. Asia/Shanghai works; UTC host would falsely reject.
findings.impact: false rejection only; no unsafe admission.
findings.minimal_fix: compare epoch via systemctl --timestamp=unix, or verify timedatectl and timer actual next elapse before launch.

findings.title: README still states 22 CPU tests and 15 container cases
findings.evidence: current local validation is 92 CPU tests; the 15 container cases are path-boundary v2 evidence, not the current full R1 run.
findings.minimal_fix: update README to 92 CPU tests and current scope before deployment; keep path-boundary evidence separate.

findings.title: staged release requires manual stop order and one-shot evidence files
findings.evidence: ray release stages allow only run-monitor13; allstopped requires pids.current 0; monitor and both observers must be stopped. No automatic stop helper; open('x') prevents rerunning a failed stage in the same run directory.
findings.impact: wrong order fails closed and needs a new run; no false pass.
findings.minimal_fix: document and execute the exact stop order; optionally add a bounded stop helper; never overwrite failed evidence.

findings.title: sllm_store.proto/grpc/.venv are external to the 54-file package
findings.evidence: bootstrap imports grpc and sllm_store.proto in the service process; those are bound by the 1,142 parent audit and .venv/Store-source-v7, not by the 54-file control manifest.
findings.impact: if the venv/proto is absent or mismatched, G1 fails at control-plane readiness; not a static source defect.
findings.minimal_fix: at G1 preflight, import the proto/grpc and record versions/paths; verify the venv and Store-source-v7 proto.
